title: StewardMD Hospital-Specific Protocol Implementation
description: OPTIONAL per-hospital-tenant overlay of a global StewardMD Standard Protocol. One layer per hospital, keyed by hospitalId (GIMSR, AIIMS, APOLLO, CUSTOM, ...); NO hospital is the default or hard-coded. Mirrors the existing kb/policies/<HOSPITAL>.json + policy-overlay.schema.json tenant pattern. A hospital may configure formulary/availability/biosimilar/workflow/approval/supportive-care/dose-modification WITHOUT modifying the global Standard Protocol. It never changes clinical evidence; if the evidence itself differs, that is a different StewardMD core protocol version, not an implementation overlay. A new global core version NEVER silently overwrites a hospital implementation.

hospitalId.description: Tenant id, e.g. GIMSR, AIIMS, APOLLO, CUSTOM. One overlay file/object per hospital.

baseProtocolId.description: id of the global StewardMD Standard Protocol this implements.

baseProtocolVersion.description: The exact global protocolVersion this overlay was built against, e.g. '2.1'.

overlay.description: Only the hospital-specific deltas; anything omitted inherits from the global protocol.

supportiveCarePolicy.description: Local antiemetic / G-CSF policy where institutionally approved.

doseModificationPolicy.description: Local dose-modification policy where institutionally approved. Never invents doses.

hospitalApprovalStatus.description: Tenant-level HOSPITAL APPROVAL, distinct from StewardMD platform CLINICAL APPROVAL on the base protocol.
